reasoning: The action sequence shows a clear, ordered campaign — understand the eval/checkpoint export, run a fine-tune, evaluate, screen multiple checkpoints, persist the best — which matches the level-5 anchor (eval running, fine-tune, measure, iterate toward the terminal target). It reaches toward level 8 by de-risking the checkpoint-export path early and screening intermediate checkpoints for information value, but falls short of 8 because there is no observed tiny end-to-end validation run before the expensive one and no explicit per-stage numeric go/no-go thresholds. I settle at 5, with medium confidence given the index contains actions but no prose done-criteria.
